name: Parkari Koli
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress
sweep_summary: Parkari Koli (park1237, kvx) is not in the catalog. the list of works with stress in the title holds a single stress/prosody-titled item, Fuchs 2023 'Analysing the speech rhythm of New Englishes' (Benjamins, closed-access); its OpenAlex abstract shows it is a syllable-/stress-timing case study of Pakistani, Nigerian, Philippine and British English, attached to park1237 only by Glottolog's computerized keyword assignment ('analysing', from the title of the language's Glottolog's most extensive description, Hoyle 2008). Relevance: other language/variety, priority none. Glottolog 5.3's JSON for park1237 lists just two Glottolog's most extensive descriptions: Hoyle 2008 (discourse study with unmarked-stress IPA texts; a full-text search for stress/accent, silent on Parkari stress) and Grainger & Grainger 1980 (3-page wordlist; per Zubair 2016:14 the surveyors 'did not mark stress'). only Hoyle 2008 on record), Wikipedia (orthography table only), IAL Trust IPA wordlist (no stress marks). Ethnologue, benjamins. No first-hand statement of Parkari Koli word-stress placement was read; no new stress statement was found. (, plus the earlier Hoyle 2008 PDF/txt and IAL wordlist). Remaining acquisition targets (all print/unpublished, low priority): Grainger & Grainger 1980 survey; Hoyle & Paschal (eds.) 2002/2022 Parkari-Urdu-English dictionary (its introduction is the likeliest place for a phonology note); Jeffery (ed.) 1999 Sindh survey.
